claim: Decides whether the depth planes are only described inside one prompt or actually rendered and composited as separate images. A director reaches for generated_separate when a foreground element has to move independently of the character, and stays on tag_hinted when they just want a flat generation to imply depth for free.
not_visual: This is a pipeline/compositing setting, not image content. It governs how the frame is produced (one bake, tag hints, mask-driven, or separate generations composited), not what appears in it — all four options can legitimately produce the identical still, so the panels would be indistinguishable and the card would teach nothing. Demonstrate it with a layer-breakdown diagram or a moving clip, not a still.
